capabilities.scope: Skill discovery and body loading in an interactive session.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing how skill metadata or bodies enter context.

probe.gesture: Invoked a named skill in a live session and compared the roster available before invocation with the content available after it.
probe.outcome: Before invocation the roster carried each skill's name and one-line description only. The full body arrived only on invocation.

capabilities.scope: Context a non-fork subagent receives at dispatch.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing what a subagent's initial context contains.

probe.gesture: Dispatched a subagent and required it to report facts that existed only in the parent conversation.
probe.outcome: The subagent reported no access to parent conversation content and re-derived every fact from files it opened itself.

capabilities.scope: Whether a subagent may dispatch a subagent, and to what depth.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing the default spawn depth or its environment override.
